note: 'Find it twice' (v14): a short sentence read aloud with a picture. He taps the target word every time it shows. Use only Dorian's confirmed sight words as targets; other words in a sentence are said by the voice and shown, but are never asked for.

sentences.text: I see the dog. I like the dog.
Look at me. Look at my cat.
We like the apple. We see the apple.
She is in the tub. She is with me.
It is my ball. I like it.
Make it with me. Make it with my dad.
I am in the box. Look in the box.
See me jump. See me go.
I am big. I am strong.
We make art. We like it.
Look at it. Look at the cat.
She is with me. She is my mom.
We are big. We are fast.
That is my dog. I like that dog.
Some of the cats ate one of the cookies.
Look at that! That is a red ball.
They are big. They like me.
I like you. We like you.
We do it. I do it.
